attempts.reason: The referenced asset worktree was removed before assets could be prepared.
The harness detected competing CPU work and stopped only its own game. No tick, transport or speed result from this attempt is accepted.

The renamed replacement TU compiled, but CMake OBJECT-library consumers still linked passenger_service_database.obj. The control therefore executed Anytime completion. Replacements now keep the original basename, stale objects are removed between variants, and control/probe runtime gates reject this failure.

The loaded map encountered an existing critical NewGRF capacity-change error and paused. Driver loops continued while simulation was paused. This is excluded from the 8192-tick continuation. The corrected benchmark counts actual StateTicks and explicitly records benchmark-only error resumes.

Two clients joined, but the first client did not reach the required end progress within 120 seconds. NewGRF capacity warnings and missed-sync-frame messages are retained in the local logs. Joins alone do not establish deterministic continued operation; this attempt is not a passing multiplayer test.
The copied continuation TU included OpenTTD headers before stdafx.h. Build-Variants stopped before starting measurements; the copied driver now keeps stdafx.h first.

The corrected driver was rebuilt while the runner was waiting before launch, after its manifest snapshot. The run advanced exactly 8192 StateTicks but its binary metadata was stale. A separate continuation replay freezes the corrected binary before recording the manifest.
